title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Five Typical Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights and Manufacturing and Selling Counterfeit and Shoddy Goods
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Releases Five Typical Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights and Manufacture and Sale of Counterfeit and Shoddy Goods

To coordinate with the national special campaign against infringement of intellectual property rights and the manufacture and sale of counterfeit and shoddy goods, to intimidate lawbreakers, to effectively protect intellectual property rights, and to maintain the order of the socialist market economy, the Supreme People's Court has released a second batch of five typical cases of infringement of intellectual property rights and manufacture and sale of counterfeit and shoddy goods:

I. Defendant Wei Youjun, Zhong Shixin – Copyright Infringement Case

The Cangnan County People's Court of Zhejiang Province found the following facts upon trial: In March 2010, Defendant Wei Youjun accepted a commission from Xie Mingqi (handled separately) to print a batch of the "Shanghai Urban Area 2010 Edition Traffic Map" compiled by the Shanghai Institute of Surveying and Mapping and published and distributed by Shanghai Science Popularization Press. On March 12 of the same year, Wei Youjun commissioned the Xinda Printing Factory in Pingyang County, Zhejiang Province to print the pirated maps, providing printing paper and film. The legal representative of Xinda Printing Factory, Defendant Zhong Shixin, accepted the business without any legal formalities and printed over 33,000 copies of the "Shanghai Urban Area 2010 Edition Traffic Map," profiting more than RMB 5,000. On March 15, when Wei Youjun transported the printed pirated maps to the Friendship Color Printing Factory in Longgang Town, Cangnan County for folding and processing, they were seized. On September 25, Zhong Shixin returned the illegal gains of RMB 5,000.

The Cangnan County People's Court found Defendants Wei Youjun and Zhong Shixin guilty of copyright infringement. It sentenced Wei Youjun to three years and two months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 10,000; sentenced Zhong Shixin to three years' imprisonment, suspended for four years, and a fine of RMB 10,000; and confiscated the 33,000 copies of the pirated maps involved. After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, neither defendant appealed, and the judgment has taken legal effect.

II. Defendant Liang Liyong – Copyright Infringement Case

The Xixiangtang District People's Court of Nanning City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region found the following facts upon trial: Defendant Liang Liyong invested in and operated the Nanning Lingfeng Printing Factory in Beihu Village, Xixiangtang District, Nanning City. For the purpose of profit, without the permission of the copyright owner, he reproduced 331,739 copies of books in which others held copyright. As determined by appraisal, the value was RMB 848,173.

The Xixiangtang District People's Court found Liang Liyong guilty of copyright infringement and sentenced him to four years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 500,000; the seized pirated books were ordered to be confiscated. After the judgment was pronounced, Liang Liyong refused to accept it and appealed. The Nanning Intermediate People's Court of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, upon trial, held that the original judgment was correct in its characterization, but because the pirated books printed by Liang Liyong had not been sold or circulated into society and he had not obtained illegal gains, the social harm was relatively minor, so a lighter punishment could be imposed at discretion. It accordingly commuted Liang Liyong's sentence to three years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 500,000.

III. Defendant Mai Jianxing – Counterfeit Registered Trademark Case

The First People's Court of Zhongshan City, Guangdong Province found the following facts upon trial: Without the permission of the owner of the registered trademark "ZIPPO," Defendant Mai Jianxing processed accessories such as shells for "ZIPPO" lighters at the Kalu Metal Products Factory in Dongfeng Town, Zhongshan City, which he operated, and commissioned the Lilang Hardware Processing Shop in Xiaolan Town, Zhongshan City to inscribe the "ZIPPO" and other graphic marks on the lighter accessories using lasers. He then assembled the accessories into finished products, packaged them, and stored them in a rental house. Upon inspection by the Zhongshan City Bureau of Quality and Technical Supervision, a total of 360 finished counterfeit lighters bearing the registered trademark "ZIPPO," valued at RMB 72,000; 9,750 unpackaged finished counterfeit lighters, valued at RMB 1,852,500; and a batch of accessories, packaging materials, and production tools were seized from the three locations.

The First People's Court of Zhongshan City found Defendant Mai Jianxing guilty of counterfeiting a registered trademark, and, being a recidivist, he should be given a heavier punishment. It sentenced Mai Jianxing to five years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 1,000,000. After the judgment was pronounced, Mai Jianxing refused to accept it and appealed. The Zhongshan Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province, upon trial, rejected Mai Jianxing's appeal and affirmed the original judgment.

IV. Defendant Qiu Haiying et al. – Counterfeit Registered Trademark Case

The Hohhot Intermediate People's Court of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region found the following facts upon trial: Between April and July 2008, Defendants Qiu Haiying, Cui Liuzhi, Yan Shuangquan, Yan Qingwen, and Huang Xueli, without the permission of the owner of the registered trademark, Inner Mongolia Yili Industrial Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Yili Company), jointly invested in and cooperated in producing a total of 117,571 units (cases) of ice cream products bearing the counterfeited registered trademark "Qiaolezi" and a total of 3,947 units (cases) of ice cream products bearing the counterfeited registered trademark "Cartoon Character (Big Pudding)" in Qiankou Village, Qiankou Township, Nanle County, Henan Province. The amount of illegal business operations totaled RMB 3,119,998. The actions of the five defendants also infringed on Yili Company's design patent rights for the said two products. During this period, Qiu Haiying cooperated with Defendant Yan Zhongbo, and without the permission of the owner of the registered trademark, Inner Mongolia Mengniu Dairy (Group) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Mengniu Company), processed and produced a total of 110,855 units (cases) of ice cream products bearing the counterfeited registered trademark "Green Mood" in Qiankou Village, Qiankou Township, Nanle County, Henan Province. The amount of illegal business operations totaled RMB 1,773,680. The actions of the two defendants also infringed on Mengniu Company's design patent rights for the said product.

The Hohhot Intermediate People's Court found Defendants Qiu Haiying, Cui Liuzhi, Yan Shuangquan, Yan Qingwen, Yan Zhongbo, and Huang Xueli guilty of both the crime of counterfeiting a registered trademark and the crime of counterfeiting a patent. In accordance with the law, it chose the heavier crime, the crime of counterfeiting a registered trademark, for sentencing. Based on the circumstances of each defendant's crime and their roles in the joint crime, they were sentenced to imprisonment ranging from five years to two years and six months, and fines ranging from RMB 2,446,839 to RMB 311,999.80. After the judgment was pronounced, none of the defendants appealed, and the judgment has taken legal effect.

V. Defendant Wu Genchuang et al. – Selling Counterfeit and Shoddy Products Case

The Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court of Zhejiang Province found the following facts upon trial: In January 2009, Defendants Wu Genchuang, Ma Chenjia, and Xiao Zemin conspired to set up a transit station for transporting counterfeit cigarettes in Cixi City, Zhejiang Province. In March, the transit location was moved to Yiwu City. Between February and April 2009, Wu Genchuang, Ma Chenjia, Xiao Zemin, together with Defendants Shen Youcai, Chen Jianping, Tang Xizhao, and hired workers Ma Zhaojie, Ma Xianyao, and Ma Guijin, transported counterfeit cigarettes sent from Fujian Province to the transit station to downstream buyers in Hangzhou and other places. They transported counterfeit cigarettes 28 times, with a total sales amount of RMB 7,860,000. Wu Genchuang and Ma Chenjia participated in all 28 instances of transporting counterfeit cigarettes.

The Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court found all nine defendants, including Wu Genchuang, guilty of selling counterfeit and shoddy products. Based on the circumstances of each defendant's crime and their roles in the joint crime, it sentenced Wu Genchuang and Ma Chenjia to life imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property; the remaining defendants were sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment ranging from fifteen years to three years and fines ranging from RMB 1,500,000 to RMB 60,000. After the judgment was pronounced, Wu Genchuang, Ma Chenjia, Xiao Zemin, Ma Xianyao, and Shen Youcai refused to accept it and appealed. The High People's Court of Zhejiang Province, upon trial, rejected the appeals of all appellants and affirmed the original judgment.
